statement: Both all-prime cusp assertions for every dihedral two-power times odd-abelian geometric closure
notes: Registered after full root, DE and PBC proof/source audits PASS and exact certificate rerun PASS. Coprime subgroup splitting identifies every actual intermediate with a connected odd elliptic-isogeny pullback of a dihedral intermediate. The extended compact-type Abel map supplies the actual semistable map. The total nilpotent closure separately supplies potential good Jacobian and a tree, avoiding the false claim that an etale pullback always preserves compact type. Every rational cusp-joining subtree maps constantly to O and lifts as literal disjoint copies, with a distinct companion on the selected copy. A42 supplies full fixed inertia and A59 normalizers, without any new p-rank-zero assertion. Products of two nonabelian Sylows and the universal A5 statement remain Open.
